Strands 1–5 are the whole syllabus. Section B of the syllabus document is the shared synthetic geometry course, delivered by chapters 15–17 and not a strand. Assessment, measured off the SEC papers rather than read from the syllabus: at Higher and Ordinary, two papers of 300 marks each, every paper split 150 marks of Section A (concepts and skills, 6 questions at 30 marks) and 150 of Section B (contexts and applications, 4 questions at 50 marks). At Foundation, ONE paper of 300 marks. The 2021 and 2022 papers are 220 marks — reduced COVID-era papers, not the current format. See research/curriculum/ie-curriculum.md section 8a.
